Class OrientedSprite

java.lang.Object
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.sprite.OrientedSprite
All Implemented Interfaces:
Sprite
public class OrientedSprite extends Object implements Sprite
Represents a sprite whose texture depends on its orientation. Each orientation refers to a texture position in an atlas.
